name: Mandoca (Fried Breaded Pepper)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Oil (enough to fill the deep fryer)

steps: Roll the pepper in the flour until well-coated.

culture.text: A mandoca is a Venezuelan deep fried, ring-shaped food, made with a mix of plantains and cornmeal. It is usually served at breakfast, with butter, cheese and coffee, and it is most popular in the Venezuelan states of Zulia and Falcón. Mandocas are one of a variety of culinary specialties of Zulia.
